Name: Livestock Choices - Continued
Author: recon88
Description:
[size=5]Overview[/size]
[size=2]This mod allows you to purchase specific breeds of chickens and cows, including Blue, Void, and Golden chickens.[/size]


[size=5]Use[/size]
[size=2]Enabled the mod and visit Marnie to buy any type of chicken and cow you want.
To be able to buy the blue chicken you must have already seen the event.
Blue, void, and golden chicken prices can be set in the config and also be disabled if you don't want them to be shown in Marnie's shop.[/size]


[size=5]Config[/size]
[code]{
  "EnableMod": true,
  "CanBuyBlueChicken": true,
  "CanBuyVoidChicken": true,
  "CanBuyGoldenChicken": true,
  "BlueChickenPrice": 800,
  "VoidChickenPrice": 1000,
  "GoldenChickenPrice": 5000
}

[/code]

[size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/size]
[*][size=2]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size]
[/list]
